title: Google picks Bezos' Blue Origin to launch AI computing satellites in 2029
summary: Companies including Elon Musk's SpaceX and startup Starcloud are exploring data centers in orbit as growing AI use drives demand for computing capacity and strains infrastructure supporting facilities on the ground.
llm_summary: Google has selected Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origin to deploy AI‑computing satellites slated for launch in 2029, aiming to offload some of the massive processing load from Earth‑bound data centers. The move comes as rivals like Elon Musk’s SpaceX and newcomer Starcloud also explore orbital data‑center concepts to meet the surging demand for AI compute power. By putting chips in space, these companies hope to bypass terrestrial bandwidth
